title: 长句的主干与修饰
goal: 找出长句的主语和谓语，确定修饰成分的对象。

points.label: 找出长句的主语和谓语
确定从句与短语修饰的对象

body.p: 长句的主干是主语和谓语。定语从句、分词短语和同位语补充名词的信息。and、or 等并列连词连接同类的成分。

body.box: The samples that survived the fire were stored in a cabinet.

body.p: 主语中心词是 samples，谓语是 were stored。that survived the fire 修饰 samples。

cards.title: 定语从句
rows: The map that the archivist found in a wooden box showed a route across the valley and included several notes about the location of bridges.
map showed a route
that 从句修饰 map。
The volunteers who completed the first task in a quiet room returned the following week to take part in a second study of visual attention.
volunteers returned
who 从句修饰 volunteers。
The samples that remained dry during transport were labelled separately before the team compared them with the material collected from the lower section of the site.
samples were labelled
that 从句修饰 samples。
The bridge which crosses the narrow channel connects the old workshop with a path that leads directly to the river and the storage building beyond it.
bridge connects workshop with path
which 从句修饰 bridge。

cards.title: 分词短语
rows: The jars stored beneath the floor contained fragments of grain, while the vessels placed beside the wall held no visible remains of food or liquid.
jars contained fragments
stored 短语修饰 jars。
The engineer examining the inlet recorded a crack in the pipe before closing the valve and asking a colleague to inspect the damaged section separately.
engineer recorded a crack
examining 短语修饰 engineer。
The notes written during the first survey were compared with a later drawing that showed the same entrance after the surrounding wall had been repaired.
notes were compared
written 短语修饰 notes。
The students working on the model measured the gate before selecting materials that would allow its moving parts to be demonstrated to visitors at a public exhibition.
students measured the gate
working 短语修饰 students。

cards.title: 同位语
rows: The inlet, a narrow opening at the base of the tank, carried water towards the pump through a short pipe fitted with a removable filter.
inlet carried water
a narrow opening 解释 inlet。
Mara Bell, a researcher in the second group, compared the drawings with the original plan before reporting the differences to the rest of the team.
Mara Bell compared drawings
a researcher 解释 Mara Bell。
The replica, a small model of the original gate, showed how the panels moved when water passed through the channel beneath the glass floor of the museum display.
replica showed how the panels moved
a small model 解释 replica。
The depot, a building beside the old railway, stored replacement parts for the engines that were maintained by skilled workers at the neighbouring repair yard.
depot stored parts
a building 解释 depot。

cards.title: 并列成分
rows: The team measured the inlet and inspected the filter before recording both results in a notebook that was kept beside the pump throughout the trial.
team measured and inspected
并列谓语 measured 和 inspected。
The team measured the inlet and the filter before recording both dimensions in a notebook that was kept beside the pump throughout the first trial.
team measured inlet and filter
并列宾语 inlet 和 filter。
A map of the harbour and a drawing of the bridge were displayed together in the library, where visitors could compare the two representations of the area.
map and drawing were displayed
并列主语 map 和 drawing。
The researcher checked the labels and the dates on the boxes before sending the collection to a second laboratory for further analysis of the contents.
researcher checked labels and dates
并列宾语 labels 和 dates。

groups.text: The jars stored beneath the floor contained grain, while the vessels beside the wall held only fragments of pottery from an earlier stage of occupation.

items.stem: Which is the main subject and verb of the first clause?
items.why: jars 是主语，contained 是谓语。stored beneath the floor 是分词短语，修饰 jars。

groups.text: The inlet, a narrow opening beside the pump, carried water into a tank where it could be stored until the gardeners needed it during dry weather.

items.why: a narrow opening 是 inlet 的同位语。

groups.text: The engineer who examined the valve recorded a fault before a colleague replaced the damaged part and tested the flow of water through the pipe.

items.why: 主干是 engineer recorded a fault；who 从句修饰 engineer。

groups.text: The team inspected the cover and repaired the filter before restarting the pump and checking whether the flow had returned to its earlier level.

items.why: 并列谓语 repaired 后的宾语是 the filter。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about a map that was found in a box.
items.why: that 从句修饰单数 map，主干谓语用 was damaged。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about an engineer examining a valve.
items.why: who examined the valve 修饰 engineer，recorded 是主干谓语。

groups.text: The archivist who opened a sealed box found a drawing of an old gate. The drawing, a plan prepared for a workshop, included measurements of the frame. A photograph stored beside the plan showed the gate after repairs. The archivist compared the drawing and the photograph before recording the differences in a catalogue. The photograph showed a handle absent from the drawing. The catalogue kept the two items separate so that the later handle would not be mistaken for part of the original design. A second archivist checked the entries before the collection was displayed.

items.stem: What is the main subject and verb of the first sentence?
items.why: 主语是 archivist，谓语是 found。第二项 archivist opened 是定语从句 who opened a sealed box 里的主谓，不是主干。

items.stem: What does 'a plan prepared for a workshop' describe?
items.why: a plan prepared for a workshop 是 drawing 的同位语。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the drawing found by the archivist.
items.why: that the archivist found 修饰 drawing，included 是主干谓语。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the photograph stored beside the plan.
items.why: that was stored beside the plan 修饰 photograph；showed 是谓语。

groups.text: The technician examining the pump found a loose cover near its inlet. The cover, a metal plate held by two screws, protected the moving parts from debris. The technician tightened the screws and checked the filter before restarting the pump. A colleague measured the water flow and the pressure after the machine had restarted. The two measurements were entered in separate columns in a record book. This allowed the team to compare later results with the earlier figures. The technician returned the following day to check whether the cover remained secure.

items.stem: What is the main subject and verb of the first sentence?
items.why: 主干是 technician found a loose cover。第四项的 examining 是分词，examining the pump 修饰 technician，不是谓语。

items.stem: Which two things did the colleague measure?
options: The water flow and the filter
items.why: measured 后面是并列宾语 the water flow and the pressure。filter 是技术员检查的，第二项只对了一半。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the technician examining the pump.
items.why: who examined the pump 修饰 technician，found 是主干谓语。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the filter checked by the technician.
items.why: that 从句修饰单数 filter，主干谓语是 was inspected。
